text:
ashley: quick check — packaging meter rollout: who owns final metering adapter for v2 rateplan? @sam @nina please. Need blockers before EOW.

sam: I can own the adapter code; blocked on billing API schema finalization. pinging @nina for contract constraints.

nina: contract constraints: enterprise plans require quota reservation flag; billing team needs a 'commit_start' and 'commit_end' fields in invoice payload. I flagged a PR in billing-protos. :link: https://git.redwood/billing-protos/pull/412

lee (PM): timeline: QA cut on Thu, release Fri. If billing schema isn't merged by Wed AM we hit risk. Can we get a fallback? :eyes: 

sam: fallback plan: adapter reads both old/new fields, feature-flagged. I'll open PR today, but needs review from @jon for quota integration.

jon: noted — will review PR tonight. I'll take ownership of quotas wiring (reserve + release). ETA tomorrow noon PDT.

nina: also, metering needs usage-tier mapping — @ashley can you confirm mapping table? I'll sync with billing afterwards.

ashley: confirmed mapping table in /docs/pkg/metering/tier-mapping.md — small update needed: remove legacy 'units' col, add 'meter_unit_id'. I'll push patch by EOD. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: [autoscan] Contract constraints check: found 1 mismatch in sandbox contracts vs expected schema. See /ci/contract-check/3180223339-report

sam: thanks billing-bot — link looks like the schema error nina mentioned. I'll include a compatibility shim.

lee (PM): can we get a quick checklist: owners + blockers + decision? I'll paste in PR description once items resolved.

jon: owners: adapter: sam; quotas wiring: jon; contract/schema: nina; mapping doc: ashley; PM: lee. Blockers: billing schema merge (nina), doc patch (ashley), code review (jon). Decision: proceed with feature-flagged shim if schema delayed.

ashley: ack. I'm adding a short note to the release playbook about the feature flag and rollback steps.

sam: I'll put the PR in draft and ping reviewers. ping @sam

nina: will prioritize schema PR review tomorrow morning.

lee (PM): perfect — wrap up: if schema merges by Wed 10am, no fallback; else we ship shim behind FF. Thanks all. :rocket:
